summary: Flat south kerb on a quiet residential street; homes across the road and behind.

best_section.where: South kerb of Auburn Terrace, beside the driveway and bushy verge before the corner

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 14-15 m away across the road, plus unit blocks close behind the south verge; homes all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked along both kerbs; room for a van at the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street with a junction at the end.
drivers.convention: Parked cars are common here; no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Steep only at the west end (mean 6.8%); flat at the best section
Homes within about 25 m all round
Near junction with a main road
sun_shade: Part-shaded by a large tree on the north verge and bushy plantings on the south.
cannot_judge: Driveway use on the south side
